title: Kindred Expansion
body:
# Kindred Souls: Guardian & Ward Expansion

> **Addon for Kindred Souls**

Despite the description previously stating it was created in *MCreator*, this is **not** the case.  
All systems and mechanics were written in **fully custom code**. MCreator was used **only as a compiler**, not for logic or feature creation.

This addon introduces **new Guardian and Ward classes**, expanding the bond mechanics within Kindred Souls.

---

# New Classes

## Vigil

A **Vigil** is a being born **half-angel and half something else**, mysteriously tied to a **Ward from birth**.  
Their power is centered around **protection, support, and divine transformation**.

### Abilities

**Effect Share**  
Share your active potion effects with another player.

**Healing Radius**  
Continuously heal your assigned **Ward** while they remain within a specified radius.

---

### Guardian Form

When activated, the Vigil transforms into their **Guardian Form**, unlocking additional divine abilities.

> ⚠️ *Make sure to check your keybinds to activate Guardian Form abilities.*

#### Guardian Form Powers

- **Flight** – Take to the skies with divine wings.  
- **Divine Wrath** – Channel celestial power against enemies.

---

## Demon Contract

A darker path forged through a **binding contract**.

When a **Demon** bonds with a **Ward**, their fates become intertwined.  
If the Ward dies, **the demon dies as well**, making the bond one of both protection and sacrifice.

### Traits

- Can **consume Rotten Flesh** as if it were **Golden Carrots**.
- Gains access to **Demon Form**.

---

### Demon Form

When transformed, the demon gains powerful infernal abilities.

**Passive Effects**

- Resistance III  
- Fire Resistance  

**Abilities**

- **Demon Fireball** – Launch destructive infernal projectiles.

---

# Future Plans

More abilities, classes, and mechanics are planned.

The next update will release **alongside Kindred Souls for Minecraft 1.21.1 (NeoForge)**.

Stay tuned.
